description: The file defines the 'Html' class, a parser and reader for HTML files into PhpSpreadsheet objects. It includes methods for loading HTML content from files or strings, parsing DOM elements, handling inline styles, images, and structural elements to convert HTML into spreadsheet data, and managing sheet properties.

classes.name: Html
classes.description: A class for reading and converting HTML files into PhpSpreadsheet Spreadsheet objects, with parsing, styling, and image handling capabilities.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Checks if the specified file appears to be a valid HTML file based on its content and structure.

methods.name: loadSpreadsheetFromFile
methods.description: Creates a new Spreadsheet object and loads HTML content from a file into it.

methods.name: setInputEncoding
methods.description: Sets the input encoding for reading HTML content (deprecated).

methods.name: getInputEncoding
methods.description: Gets the current input encoding setting (deprecated).

methods.name: loadFromString
methods.description: Loads a Spreadsheet from an HTML string content, parsing and converting the HTML DOM.

methods.name: loadIntoExisting
methods.description: Loads HTML content from a file into an existing Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: loadDocument
methods.description: Converts a DOMDocument into a PhpSpreadsheet spreadsheet, parsing all DOM elements.

methods.name: getSheetIndex
methods.description: Returns the current sheet index to load into.

methods.name: setSheetIndex
methods.description: Sets the sheet index for loading.

methods.name: applyInlineStyle
methods.description: Applies inline CSS styles to a cell based on HTML style attribute, supporting background, font, border, and alignment styles.

methods.name: getStyleColor
methods.description: Converts a color value (hex code or color name) into an RGB string for styling.

methods.name: insertImage
methods.description: Inserts an image into a worksheet at specified column and row, based on src and other attributes.

methods.name: loadProperties
methods.description: Extracts meta tags from HTML DOM and assigns properties (author, title, etc.) to a Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: replaceNonAscii
methods.description: Replaces non-ASCII characters with HTML numeric character references.

methods.name: loadDocument
methods.description: Loads a DOMDocument into a Spreadsheet, parsing all content and preparing sheets.

methods.name: getBorderStyle
methods.description: Returns the corresponding PhpSpreadsheet border style for a given HTML border style.

methods.name: setBorderStyle
methods.description: Maps HTML border styles to PhpSpreadsheet border styles and applies to a cell style.
